run_interactive_maze: run an interactive maze environment with keyboard controls for navigation and object manipulation
run_maze_screenshot: run the maze environment and save a screenshot to a specified file path
run_maze_agent_view: run the maze environment rendering the agent's partially observable view alongside the full maze
run_ued_maze: run a UED maze environment with a separate render environment for visualization
review_key_handler: review the key_handler function that maps keyboard events to maze actions like left, right, forward, pickup, and drop
